title: Practicing in the beginning
summary: He practiced before and after his day job, waking the neighbors.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: And you took up Clarenette, how much did you practice in the beginning when you first started?

Well, I practiced every chance that I got. And I was waking, I was waking at the daytime. I'd go to work at 7 o'clock in the morning and knock off at 5.30 in the evening. And I'd get up in the morning before I'd go to work and wake people in the neighborhood.
And the time I'd come home in the evening, get something to eat, I'd go right back to it.
